name: agrinexus-server
description: Express Backend for Farm-to-Table MERN App

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: start "AgriLink Server" cmd /k "npm --prefix server run dev" & start "AgriLink Client" cmd /k "npm --prefix client run dev"
